card.name: Calories and amounts per gram
card.fires_on: Numbers and units in statements of how much energy, lipid or mineral a nutrient provides per gram or mL, especially fat's 9 calories per gram. Also nearby words like calories, kcal, content and solution.

modes.label: Calories per gram
modes.description: The number or unit in comparisons of energy from fat, carbohydrate and protein.
modes.example: Fats provide <<9>> calories per gram compared to 4 calories

modes.label: Concentration of nutrient in a product
modes.description: The space or unit after approximately or at, giving lipid or phosphorus content per mL of a parenteral product.
modes.example: Cleviprex contains approximately<< >>0.2 g of lipid per mL
